entries.title: Exodus 2:1
segments: There went; had gone.  Amram the father of Moses had been married a number of years, and had at least two children, Miriam and Aaron, when Moses was born.

entries.title: Exodus 2:3
segments:
Slime and--pitch; to keep out the water. 
 
  River's brink; the border of the river Nile.

entries.title: Exodus 2:10
segments:
Became her son; was adopted as her son. 
 
  Moses; orginally an Egyptian word, meaning saved from the water; but, by a slight change, made to signify in Hebrew drawn out.

entries.title: Exodus 2:11
segments: Was grown; had arrived to years of maturity.  He was forty years old; was "learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians," and was "mighty in words and in deeds."

entries.title: Exodus 2:12
segments: Slew the Egyptian; Moses may have received from God an intimation that he should deliver Israel,
; but his present atempt was unauthorized and premature.

entries.title: Exodus 2:14
segments: With the first-fruits of our time, talents, property, and all that we possess, God is well pleased; and our own highest interests, as well as his glory, will be promoted by our devoting them to him.

entries.title: Exodus 2:15
segments:
Midian; a country south and south-east of Canaan, and near the Red sea. 
 
The efforts of men to perpetuate oppression may prepare the way for the deliverance of the oppressed.

entries.title: Exodus 2:16
segments: Priest of Midian; the Hebrew word for priest signifies also prince.

entries.title: Exodus 2:18
segments: Reuel; probably the same as Jethro; or, as some think, the father of Jethro.

entries.title: Exodus 2:22
segments:
Gershom; meaning, a stranger there. 
 
God has a work for each one of his people; and he bestows upon them such mercies, and leads them through such trials as are best suited to fit them to perform it.

entries.title: Exodus 2:24
segments: The measures which men adopt to thwart the purposes of God or the good of his people, are often made the means of fulfilling them.

entries.title: Exodus 2:25
segments: Had respect; viewed them with compassion, and with the purpose to deliver them.
